assertions.text: Resolves the commit list via gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/57/commits --paginate --jq '.[].sha', not a hand-typed or remembered list
Uses --paginate (or otherwise avoids a truncation risk on a large PR) and scopes to the SHA only, not the full commit object
Never reconstructs the list from a local branch assumed to match
Shows the resolved commit list back to the user for confirmation before any git cherry-pick runs
